basis: Neurologic and acrorenal defects define syndrome; auditory canal atresia in 80-99%. Ocular disease and cardiovascular malformations omitted under four-axis cap.
Congenital hypomyelinating neuropathy; fixed talipes in 1/3 supports musculoskeletal involvement. Respiratory failure may be neurogenic, without direct airway or lung damage.
Skeletal dysplasia characterized by mesomelic shortening and hypoplastic tibiae and radii.
Umbrella for Borrelia infections; no additional organ damage is established as common across the group.
Defined by congenital nasal malformation and an atrophic nasal-tip skin lesion; preserved respiration does not negate the structural nasal abnormality.
Leech infestation; external skin and internal mucosal sites vary across subtypes, without one additional organ established as commonly damaged.
Metaphyseal undermodeling and vertebral dysplasia define a skeletal disorder.
Invasive carcinoma arising in an intraductal papillary-mucinous neoplasm of the exocrine pancreas.
Isolated displacement of the lens and pupil, with associated ocular structural abnormalities.
Inherited erythrocyte membrane disorder causing elliptocytosis and possible hemolysis; jaundice does not establish liver damage.
KRT6B-related nail dystrophy, palmoplantar keratoderma and cutaneous cysts.
Neonatal diabetes and developmental delay define intermediate DEND; epilepsy is absent in this form.
Neoplasm originates in the subglottic larynx, an airway site.
Fibro-osseous lesions of jaw bone and dental cementum define disease; impacted teeth occur in 30-79%. Secondary infection is occasional.
Carcinoma originating in eccrine sweat glands of the skin.
Isolated spermatogenic failure and male infertility; no endocrine dysfunction or other axis involvement is established.
Occlusion of a retinal artery directly defines both an ocular and arterial vascular disorder.
Pleural effusion is a defining diagnostic component. Ovarian neoplasm has no axis; ascites alone does not establish gastrointestinal organ damage.
Leukemia involving the erythroid hematopoietic lineage.
Progressive nephrotic glomerular disease; reduced visual acuity in 8/8, retinal detachment in 5/9 and pigmentary retinopathy in 3/9 support common direct ocular damage.
Congenital glycosylation disorder; developmental delay and intellectual disability in 2/2. Hepatomegaly in 1/2 alone does not establish hepatic dysfunction.
Bordetella parapertussis causes a pertussis-like respiratory tract infection.
Congenital fibroblastic neoplasm arising in the kidney.
Primary lung carcinoma with neuroendocrine differentiation; differentiation alone does not establish endocrine gland disease.
Suppurative skin disease; major subtypes are cutaneous infections, with immune-mediated pyoderma gangrenosum also included.
